title: Phase 3: dialect 0.2, no narrowings
description:
Source: docs/plan/2026-10-29-path-to-north-star.md (Phases).

Full lifted subset, indirect-call dispatch, function-address encoding, soft-float, vector scalarisation, effect virtualisation, taint-driven outlining under ctrl (R1), dirty borrowing, budget tables, mixed-major links. Pre-flight against the phase-1 interpreter. Council rounds to acceptance. Work items: epic b-dialect-spec-8wf in bennett-dialect-spec (40 narrowing issues plus open items C1-C7).

title: Phase 2: rung-4 feasibility spike (SQLite)
description:
Source: docs/plan/2026-10-29-path-to-north-star.md (Phases).

Unmodified SQLite (build flags recorded), in-memory database, a real SQL predicate over a superposed rowid as the oracle. Inventory of the oracle's whole callee closure by construct (memory, direct and indirect calls, FP, vectors, varargs, setjmp, libc, effects), each mapped to ISA rows or recorded as a gap. Output: bennett-dialect-spec/docs/spikes/sqlite/ (Opus agent in progress). Should also confirm the VFS-image route needs neither G-12 nor ISA-11 for rung 4 (audit §4).

title: Phase 0: audit dialect 0.1 for narrowings
description:
Source: docs/plan/2026-10-29-path-to-north-star.md (Phases).

Every §1.4 departure and every deferred decision D1-D25 classified: mechanics-only deferral (keep) vs capability narrowing (remove, with the mechanism needed). Output: bennett-dialect-spec/docs/audit/2026-10-29-dialect-0.1-narrowing-audit.md, commit 3bb2ae2 in bennett-dialect-spec. title: north star iteration 8: apply A1+A2 and run council round 7
description:
Apply north-star amendments A1 and A2 surgically to docs/Bennett-NorthStar.md as iteration 8, attach the diff, and grade it as council `northstar-2026-10-28` round 7.

- A1 (docs/council/northstar-amendments/A1-2026-10-28-control-flow-under-a-budget.md): control flow under a qubit: one budget, no per-construct bounds. Changes only §7 (landscape), adds one sentence to §4.2 and one clause to 'What is new'; supplies the sourced comparison codex requested in round 5.
- A2 (docs/council/northstar-amendments/A2-2026-10-29-legality-spike-outcomes.md): what the legality spike changed. Changes two rows of the §3.1 table (handles: provenance through bitwise copies; region operands dispatched at run time / region identity by content) and the §3.2 legality-spike bullet. Maintainer decisions of 2026-10-29. Related: bennett-dialect-spec b-dialect-spec-25h (C4: draft and grade A2).

WAITS FOR THE MAINTAINER'S GO. Anything phases 2-4 force into the north star is added to the same iteration.
Part of phase 5 (bennett-1qo).
